name: Amaral Custom Fabrications Inc
old_description: Amaral Custom Fabrications is a family owned and operated company with a rich, 20-year history. We are versatile fabricators who are able to apply our technical know-how to many industries, including large-scale sculpture and art fabrication, marine and architectural trades, and sculpture restorations, among many, many others.
about:
Amaral Custom Fabrications operates from Rumford, Rhode Island, where it has been a family-owned and operated business for roughly two decades. The company was founded by the Amaral family, though the exact year and founder names are not publicly disclosed, and it began as a versatile fabrication shop serving a range of industrial and artistic clients.

The shop specializes in hand-fabricated sculpture and art pieces, using marine-grade and aerospace-grade materials and techniques. Its capabilities span large-scale sculpture fabrication, art fabrication, marine and architectural metalwork, and sculpture restoration. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Clients come from the fine art, marine, architectural, and cultural heritage sectors. The company has produced large-scale sculptures for public installations, fabricated marine components, executed architectural metalwork, and restored existing sculptures. Specific customer names are not provided.

Amaral emphasizes its hands-on, craft-driven approach and the durability of its work, stating that its fabrication quality is intended to last for generations. The family ownership model is presented as a foundation for consistent attention to detail across diverse projects.
